artboards.title: Today: the doorbell rings while the TV is on
A: the door in a corner, over whatever is on
B: the door takes the whole screen
C: a line along the foot, the picture a press away

annotations.text:
WHY THIS EXISTS

Step 4 of the living room (20 November 2026): the hub sits at the TV, so whoever is on the sofa should see who is at the door without finding a phone. Today the hub does not notice a ring at all, on the wall or the TV; the brain's half (hearing the doorbell, from Ring or any doorbell Home Assistant brings in, and telling every screen) is the same whichever is picked.

THE SAME IN EVERY DIRECTION

Only the TV in a room is drawn here; the wall gets its own boards. It shows over the awake TV and over the resting one alike, and (once films are built) over a film, which pauses.

It goes by itself after a minute, and Back lets it go sooner. Nothing on it opens the door: OK never unlocks one (design/living-room/).

Read from the sofa: nothing under 22px, the picture live, not a still.

A: THE DOOR IN A CORNER

A live picture in the corner, over whatever was on, lit so OK makes it the whole screen and Back lets it go. The room stays in view behind it.

FOR: you see the visitor at once without losing your place, the way a phone's picture-in-picture does.

AGAINST: covers a corner of a film, and a face at 640 wide is small from three meters.

B: THE DOOR TAKES THE SCREEN

The whole TV becomes the front door, live, with the porch light a press away, and Back returns to what was on.

FOR: a face is readable from the sofa at once, and it is unmissable.

AGAINST: the loudest of the three. It takes the screen from whoever is watching, every time, for a parcel as much as a guest.

C: A LINE ALONG THE FOOT

One line in the band's place with a small still, saying who rang and when; OK opens the live picture. The quiet way a knock already arrives (design/knock/, C with A).

FOR: the calmest, and the same shape as everything else that arrives on the TV.

AGAINST: the still is small, so you press OK to see who it is.

DECIDED 20 NOVEMBER 2026

A: the door in a corner, over whatever is on. Live where the camera will stream, its newest picture while it connects; OK makes it the whole screen, Back lets it go, and it goes by itself after a minute.
